prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and precise-object-edit.
Asset: a cohesive organ-support UNDERLAY for a cute geometric top-down cell-battle game, positioned between the body/muscle background and separately authored organ-floor overlays.
INPUT IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact anatomical layout. INPUT IMAGE 2 is STYLE ONLY: the accepted warm peach/pink matte geometric game art with shallow cream bevels. Do not copy its flower or triangle obstacles into this image.
Preserve the exact portrait canvas proportions, all image margins, framing, position, scale and main outer shapes of EVERY organ in image 1. The two lungs, central heart, broad liver on viewer left, stomach on viewer right, pancreas below stomach, both kidneys, large/small intestine and bladder must stay at exactly their current locations. This is NOT an exploded anatomy diagram. It must feel like one connected anatomy illustration, with softly overlapping organ backs, little supporting lobes, gentle warm connective tissue beds and natural transitions filling the small spaces between organs.
Refine the existing anatomy in an exquisite but friendly CUTE GEOMETRIC ANIME mobile-game map style matching image 2: smooth clean rounded polygon masses, controlled terracotta outlines, tasteful two/three-tone cel shading, restrained shallow cream bevels, warm peach/coral/rose tissue, yellow-peach pancreas, warm pink/red liver and kidneys. Detailed, crisp, matte and inviting. No wet realistic flesh.
Retain smooth natural full-organ forms under the later playable floor overlays; particularly preserve the stomach's upper continuation and rounded lower duodenal loop as one continuous softly curved digestive structure flowing into the intestines. Make the intestine forms broad, softly rounded geometric lobules, not thin wriggling worms. Integrate lungs/heart above and digestive organs below with a calm continuous warm tissue backing. NO isolated floating organs, NO separate platforms or pedestals, NO little bridges or planks or mechanical pipes.
Remove all superficial red/blue/yellow branching blood-vessel drawings from heart and kidneys, and remove the white tree-shaped bronchial branches from lung faces; those are independent upper layers. The central main airway may remain as a single friendly ivory rounded tube. Recolor the tiny green gallbladder to warm peach/ochre so there is NO green. Do not add any red/blue vascular tubes.
Remove the body-outline muscle/bone surroundings from this crop: output ONLY the united thoracic/abdominal organ assemblage with its soft supporting connective-tissue backing on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. The assemblage has a natural scalloped curved perimeter following the outer sides of lungs, liver/stomach, kidneys, intestines and bladder. The outer margin must NEVER be a rectangle or straight-sided crop patch. Do not paint shoulders, arms, pelvis bones or a giant outer rectangular canvas-colored panel. The organ assemblage stays in precisely the same positions as input1, including blank margins; no recentering, no magnification, no mirroring.
Very high native detail, highest available portrait resolution (about 1536x2730 or larger). Clean smooth contours designed for close-up game inspection, no chunky pixels.
Avoid: horror, Cthulhu, worms, tentacles, insects, deep holes, pores, slime, gore, exposed dissection, eyes/faces/characters, text, labels, UI, green, stray vessels, detached connecting planks, square or rectangular repair patches.
